name: pidgeon
description: Verified identity, inboxes and sign-in for AI agents, and a way for websites to see who runs them.

api_key.title: Pidgeon API key
api_key.description: Optional. Leave it empty and Claude Code signs you in to Pidgeon instead. For an agent with nobody there to sign in, a key from https://pidgeon.ai/keys, with the narrowest access the agent needs.
